text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O asked me to accompany her to her dance rehearsal, so I'm joining her today.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's begin the dance practice!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes! I saw it on TV yesterday! Apparently the parade here is amazing and super famous too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: In other words, it's perfect! It's OUTSTANDING! And as a model student, I intend to learn their ways!
choice_data_list: I see. So this is for studying purposes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yikes! Time flies while you're talking! Better hurry and get ready!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: First, let's go and buy a penlight! It's apparently part of the formalities to wave them at parades. How refined!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah, they're selling churros and soda over there! I heard they are also essential items! Let's go and get some!
choice_data_list: Are we really here to practice?
Are we really here to practice?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Of course! They talked about all these components on TV after all! They're the secret to understanding the essence of the parade!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, with the preliminary arrangements in place, the parade finally begins…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Carrot King and Queen have made an entrance! Oh! Aaah! Oooh?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Such an amazing dance… I've gotten all pumped without even realizing! This energy! It feels like my grip could pulverize this penlight!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Such power of expression! To be able to whip up the crowd into such a frenzy! I need to learn this too, so I can bask in the applause!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh! Oh! Over there! It's Carrot King and Que—no, my masters! My venerable teachers!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Th-this is… This is my chance! Should I ask them directly about the essence of the dance?!
choice_data_list: Practice is more valuable than that!
All right! Let's go and ask.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see! Practice over theory! Understood! Let's get dancing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes! You know what they say! Strike while the iron is hot! So let's do it before I can say I forgot!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's like this! Then this! Like this… or this… Is this right?!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: Amazing! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah! Thank you for all the encouragement! I'll definitely perform well next time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Woo! Whoa! Woo, woo, whoa, whoa… hoo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Oh! That's the dance from the parade! It's exactly the same! Incredible!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Haa-ha ha ha ha! Such wonderful applause! I'll keep going!

text_block_list.name: Amusement Park Staff
text_block_list.text: What's all the commotion? …Wait, a park guest?! What do you think you're doing?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After causing a disturbance and getting scolded, Sakura Bakushin O is delighted to hear from her dance instructor that her dancing has improved the next day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we get in line for the greeting booth.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: This is it! It's my turn! I'm going to ask the experts!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I loved the parade! Please teach me how to do that dance!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah, that heart-shaped hand sign… I see! You put your heart into your movements from head to toe!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Now you're pointing at your head… Oh! In other words, by building a better understanding of the choreography, you can then express it with all your might?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: To put it frankly, you're saying it all comes down to Bakushin! Aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Of course, all roads lead to Bakushin! How could I forget? Careless, so careless!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I really appreciate the advice from you experts! I'll work on the basics and master the dance!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although I wasn't sure about how useful our excursion would be, Sakura Bakushin O is delighted when her dance instructor tells her she improved the next day.
